name: 28769-visionarena-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16. Everything else is readable off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=100, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: Real image+text chat traffic from `lmarena-ai/VisionArena-Chat`: one image and one turn per request, one token out, served from a prepared 1000-row local copy. Text is short and long-tailed (median 9 tokens); images run 137x137 to 1024x1024 and no two rows repeat. temperature 0.0.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering single-image questions for 100 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 28769-visionarena-qwen25vl7b-1gpu: one vision-language engine on one H100,
# engine commit ac1daf32337d312e7a575901da2e19857f4c0be1. Interpreter and hardware: env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

# Required by this checkpoint.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 128000
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
